mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 5% in a given month coincides with a 20-day negative S&P 500 forward return due to market anticipation of tighter policy.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.0 in the current month
regime_hint: FED Funds rate at or above 5% target zone
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from a pre-increase baseline (p > 0.05) across 10 such events.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (employment) while UNRATE falls suggests labor market softening, which precedes a 5-day positive S&P 500 forward return as investors price in weaker wage growth.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases in the same month
regime_hint: Labor market transition from tight to loose
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >70% of such labor transition events.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly drop in HOUST (residential construction) of at least 10% predicts a 20-day negative S&P 500 forward return as it signals cooling housing demand and reduced corporate earnings momentum.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases by ≥10% over two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative in 5 such events.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO (industrial production) contraction below 100 triggers a 60-day positive S&P 500 forward return as markets anticipate a recovery in business activity.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no significant outperformance vs. prior contraction months (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 4% for three consecutive months, a 20-day positive S&P 500 forward return is expected as markets anticipate rate cuts and liquidity injection.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS stays below 4.0 for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in UNRATE above 5% in a month coincides with a 5-day negative S&P 500 forward return as higher unemployment is interpreted as a risk-off move.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.0 in the current month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly declines in GDPC1 (GDP) and RSAFS (retail sales) of 2% or more predict a 20-day negative S&P 500 forward return as demand softens across sectors.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < prev and RSAFS < prev by ≥2% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in >60% of such dual declines.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month moving average of INDPRO above 105 with no prior month below 100 signals a supply expansion, leading to a 60-day positive S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns underperform a neutral benchmark (5% annualized).
